# provenance for today
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime
paths=[
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
]
day="2026-11-18"
for p in paths:
  print("===", p, "===")
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    print("MISSING"); continue
  n=0
  with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      if day not in line: continue
      n+=1
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        print(line[:300].replace('\n',' ')); continue
      # compact
      keys=['ts','time','created_at','source','kind','bus_id','id','from','to','status','summary','text','payload']
      bits=[]
      for k in keys:
        if k in o:
          v=o[k]
          if isinstance(v,dict):
            v=str(v)[:180]
          else:
            v=str(v)[:220]
          bits.append(f"{k}={v}")
      print(" | ".join(bits)[:500])
      if n>=40: print("...(cap)"); break
  print("count_day_lines",n)
PY
